records.text: Vanity Fair reported that Robert Richards IV was initially charged with two counts of second-degree child rape but accepted a plea involving an admission that he abused his children and a lesser fourth-degree rape charge.
records.speaker: Vanity Fair

appearances.snippet: He was initially charged with two counts of second-degree child rape, which would have carried a mandatory 20-year prison term if convicted. Richards—again, accused of raping two of his own children—was instead released on a $60,000 bail and eventually copped a plea deal that involved him admitting that he had abused his children but received that lesser charge: a fourth-degree rape.
